plugins.name: Stream Quality Picker
plugins.author: JZOnTheGit
plugins.description: Groups streams by resolution with smart ranking, visual badges, seeder strength bars, and one-tap Best Pick buttons.

plugins.name: Anilist Sync
plugins.author: GefyDev
plugins.description: Automated anime tracking plugin for Stremio Enhanced that seamlessly synchronizes your watched anime episodes with your AniList profile in real-time.

plugins.name: ExpandStreamTitles
plugins.description: Removes text truncation on stream links, allowing full release titles to display.
plugins.author: Enkvaros

plugins.name: Stream Keyword Filter
plugins.author: M-1u
plugins.description: Filter a movie/episode's stream list by resolution, source, video/audio codec tags (REMUX, 2160p, x265, DTS...), plus free-text keywords. Save selections as reusable, editable presets.

plugins.name: Collapsible Filters
plugins.author: M-1u
plugins.description: Adds a toggle to collapse/expand the filters row on Discover and Library, to reclaim vertical space for the grid.

plugins.name: Library Stats
plugins.author: M-1u
plugins.description: A stats panel for your Stremio Library: totals, watched split, movies vs series, and per-folder counts (works with Library Folders). No network calls.

plugins.name: Close Preview Panel
plugins.author: M-1u
plugins.description: Close/reopen Discover's item preview panel to reclaim grid width, with a small tab to bring it back.

plugins.name: Poster Size
plugins.author: M-1u
plugins.description: Choose the poster/card size (S/M/L/XL) on Discover and Library. Your choice is remembered.

plugins.name: Random Pick
plugins.author: M-1u
plugins.description: Jumps to a random item on Discover or Library, respecting active filters from other plugins (folders, watched, etc.).

plugins.name: Discover Watched Filter
plugins.author: M-1u
plugins.description: Adds a button to the Discover page to hide watched items, show only watched items, or show everything. Automatically keeps loading more pages when the current one is fully filtered out. 100% local.

plugins.name: Library Folders
plugins.author: M-1u
plugins.description: Organize your Library into folders and subfolders — right-click or drag an item to file it away, rubber-band multi-select, and bulk actions (mark all watched/unwatched, remove all). 100% local, nothing is synced.

plugins.name: Countdown Timer
plugins.author: JackVonDanger
plugins.description: Adds a countdown timer that pauses playback and exits the player after prolonged inactivity.

plugins.name: Stream Finder
plugins.author: Echo
plugins.description: Search box, quality (4K, 1080p, HDR, Dolby Vision) and audio-language filter chips for the streams list, plus a drag-to-resize streams sidebar.

plugins.name: Addon Organizer
plugins.author: Echo
plugins.description: Drag and drop your addons into the order you want, rename them, and show or hide their catalogs.

plugins.name: Lumen
plugins.author: Echo
plugins.description: A cinematic, TV-app style redesign: glass sidebar, rotating hero billboard, landscape Continue Watching, ranked Top rows and full-bleed detail pages.

plugins.name: dx.bi
plugins.author: dx.bi
plugins.description: The full dx.bi experience in one plugin, theme included: rotating billboard, Netflix-style hover previews with IMDb/Kitsu/AniList ratings, critic reviews and Rotten Tomatoes/Metacritic scores on title pages, Skip Intro & Next Episode (TheIntroDB + AniSkip), addon order & backup, subtitle styles, picture-in-picture, open in mpv/VLC, seek-bar thumbnails, black-bar removal and zoom, Dialogue boost and Night mode, one-click subtitle sync and second subtitles, Library sorting by year/rating/genre, stream sort and filter bar, end-to-end encrypted watch parties, optional Anime4K/sharpen picture enhancement, intro and UI sounds, and full keyboard browsing with the arrow keys. All configurable in Settings.
